query:
SELECT g.is_active,
            tm.team_id AS "team_id?",
            COALESCE(t.is_beta, FALSE) AS "is_beta!"
        FROM rb_game g
        LEFT JOIN rb_team_member tm
            ON tm.game_id = g.id AND tm.user_id = $2
        LEFT JOIN rb_team t ON t.id = tm.team_id
        WHERE g.id = $1;
